summary: Throw for BigInt serialization unless a callable toJSON hook transforms the BigInt before the BigInt type check.

target.notes: After toJSON and replacer processing, a remaining BigInt causes TypeError. BigInt is special because a callable toJSON property can convert it first.

semantics.hook_order: toJSON lookup/call occurs before the remaining BigInt rejection
semantics.replacer: a replacer function may also transform a BigInt before rejection if toJSON did not

caveats: A blanket 'BigInt always throws' rule is incorrect when BigInt.prototype.toJSON or another reachable toJSON lookup transforms it.

tests.name: plain BigInt throws
tests.input: try { JSON.stringify({x:1n}); } catch(e) { console.log(e instanceof TypeError); }

tests.name: BigInt toJSON can make it serializable
